name: BBQ Pork Chops & Napa Cabbage "Wedge Salad" with Blue Cheese Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place ketchup, Worcestershire, sugar, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the BBQ sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup ketchup
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a large broiler pan. Pour ⅔ of the BBQ sauce over the chops and turn to coat. Set remaining sauce aside.
Place pork chops in the oven and broil until the tops start to brown and caramelize, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add blue cheese and stir to combine the dressing; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: Remove pork chops from the oven, flip, and coat with remaining BBQ sauce. Return to the oven and broil until cooked through, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven, loosely cover with foil, and rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
3 Gala apples
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the root end of each cabbage. Cut cabbage heads into quarters lengthwise, to make six wedges.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples.
To serve, divide pork chops and cabbage wedges between plates; top wedges with dressing, apples, and chives. Enjoy!
